notes: New mod: Cave Dweller (Mods > Converted - off until you turn it on). Deep in the caves, in the dark, you hear it moving. It only shows itself where you are not looking - and when you see it, it decides: it stares and creeps closer while you look away, it runs, or it comes for you, faster than you can run.
It is the Better Cave Dweller mod by Cadentem (MIT): its model, animations and sounds, with its behaviour ported from its code. Works in singleplayer and on the server.
Invisible horror creatures no longer cast a shadow that gave them away.
